title: Astronot Mevsimi
author: Nurdan Bağrıaçık
description: What happens when a curious bear meets a lost astronaut? Astronaut Season is a heartwarming and humorous picture book that invites young readers to explore the wonders of the universe. It gently introduces astronomical concepts such as the seasons and answers basic questions about life in space. Through playful rhyme and dreamlike illustrations, it makes science approachable and encourages children to ask questions, make connections, and explore the world around and above them.
